notes.title: Character Introductions 04
notes.content:
Character Introductions:


[h3]＜Emiri Takei＞[/h3]
She attends Chukyo Academy. She gets involved with bad boys after Taiga saves her. 
She has a part-time job at a maid cafe.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42425666/fa4e15f5397f43e39e0ecdf4fa6de534152c677d.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42425666/37886b93375e106267c780b499cee4673181293d.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42425666/883734b44906e9a4f0f5a8b773b4bbcc00bf8321.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42425666/ff24a73828d5b6841853b9626637d549dbb3fd7a.png[/img]


[h3]＜Yoshiaki Nakama＞[/h3]
A student attending Chukyo Academy. 
His nickname is Glasses. He is a weak fighter and hates delinquents.
He seems to have had some falling out with the protagonist back in the day.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42425666/c0a6af3a313d86dcce35ef608a2fba797a2ada48.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42425666/2ef13a00c2f4d99dc288b6f61dd05020e0f2efd7.png[/img]


[h3]＜Aki Nakamori＞[/h3]
A 3rd-year middle school student. She is a beautiful young girl full of energy.
It's uncertain if she will become an Idol. She has a strong older brother.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42425666/c03732aa0830a5628fbef73e0a4807c50b2eb115.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42425666/f7deaf660ecf7da9f583c01271eeaaac63ea401f.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42425666/7164afbb59469ed46d6cbc8631fee3960aa2a06e.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42425666/f1a70c4cbd9419a826e9e3b8b222b93244fe30f8.png[/img]


[h3]＜Hiroko Indo＞[/h3]
She is a member of a Ladies (female bōsōzoku) biker gang who also attends Chukyo Academy.She is confident that she can beat anyone at playing arcade games. She likes strong, handsome guys.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42425666/ec2b41bc213deda290cc2383e224aba2a670f88d.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42425666/7eb9cc8ea6b76480ccf0564a82c3ac8c800ddaf5.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42425666/fcf38824d086df0328b446d3985e743260c2a965.png[/img]


[h3]＜Ayaka Ueto＞[/h3]
A student who also attends Chukyo Academy.
She is a beautiful young lady who wears glasses. She looks out for her fellow students and has a weakness for boys her junior.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42425666/3190db75b2b70d821db419fe92838fd151ba09ca.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42425666/25d37fce1a98066cb7ecb6279c5d1eb60d03b690.png[/img]

notes.title: Character Introductions 03
notes.content:
Character Introductions:


[h3]＜Yuji Ueno＞[/h3]
Taiga’s classmate. He is very hard-headed.
He is a hard worker and will do anything to be popular.
However, his results are no good.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42425666/c0e1a8a506d63b79dc416b6d4e36284a44f69806.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42425666/4b3635872c2558d3d9b815772abdeabc9ff5f218.png[/img]


[h3]＜Masaru Inoue＞[/h3]
A member of the delinquent gang, Onishura Empire, from Minato High. He tried to initiate Yuto Aragaki, but Yuto backed out. Masaru always wears a tank top because of the body heat that he has to put up with.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42425666/9e7e0e36abaff921ee38d22ad24b651b456e8c4b.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42425666/2f0683a4d8bcd934493207f6f32c3dc0dd63070c.png[/img]



[h3]＜Yukio Ichikawa＞[/h3]
Another member of the delinquent gang, Onishura Empire, from Minato High. He appears to be an intellectual and a bad boy as he participates in fights.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42425666/0ec8cb0fcd6c6068a4602e535252004a03d06780.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42425666/6694dfc54f7cd2a5c62949492c5702d5665b6996.png[/img]



[h3]＜Yuta Aoi＞[/h3]
Another member of the delinquent gang, Onishura Empire, from Minato High. His signature move is the Paper-fan Thrust. He dreams of becoming a big entertainer. He is a weirdo that fights just to be talked about.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42425666/e7bf65722c48b5c8d2399c2f09b46cf47490d130.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42425666/1feca2089e8c1a94d993205963c2bf2844206257.png[/img]

notes.title: Character Introductions 02
notes.content:
Character Introductions:


[h3]＜Masanobu Yaguchi＞[/h3]
A delinquent from Sakae High. He is a self-proclaimed enthusiast for cute girls. He takes pride in rockin’ his Regent/Pompadour hairstyle while causing chaos in the city nowadays.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42425666/e3aeb9e37c066ecbbaa787375b62d06659526d2c.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42425666/91e190d9d370f2e06583893a447f2fffbd911765.png[/img]



[h3]＜Asahi Kago＞[/h3]
Another delinquent from Sakae High. He hangs out with Yaguchi. He has freckles, wears sunglasses, and smokes cigs. He wants the same Regent Hairstyle as Yaguchi, so he tries his hardest to set his hair up these days.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42425666/5fddbe86f0c9613112a4251945078deefae72ca7.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42425666/3f31c5ef2c5d4df9e88778e1cef5ba10e01ae233.png[/img]



[h3]＜Tsuji Nozomu＞[/h3]
Another delinquent from Sakae High.
He also hangs out with Yaguchi. 
He has a small body build and a bad temper.
He dreams of joining the Regent Gang one day.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42425666/16bfa3c5b0e534d1bfda38f51aa387e58910561c.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42425666/b1217a00c72dd7d232861e5ff2d9d8e245621861.png[/img]



[h3]＜Mario Todd＞[/h3]
Another delinquent from Sakae High. He also hangs out with Yaguchi’s gang. He doesn’t seem like he wants to be a bad boy. It’s unknown if he is researching the Japanese Regent hairstyle.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42425666/8c7817c79f4dc48e1799a7d66f38a3ac4879f8fc.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42425666/6cbdfab6c8a6e9da4cef0f88906522e03f61bfed.png[/img]

notes.title: Character Introductions! No.1
notes.content:
Character Introductions:


[h3]＜Taiga Arashi＞[/h3]
he main protagonist of Banchou Tactics.
A man who causes a storm.
During his first year of high school, he tried establishing a baseball club with his close friend Haruo, but this ended up causing bad blood with...

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42425666/5e2019925e9ff7b72946bee87b73c0da89cecd43.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42425666/8cda8a6817c67bb68c675bca4d547c631309c474.png[/img]



[h3]＜Yuuto Aragaki＞[/h3]
Yuuto is known as the strongest fighter at Minato High School. 
Even the badasses of delinquents look up to him. 
His cool looks make him even more popular among young women classmates. 
He excels in kicking techniques.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42425666/2154de12d78f45e274cf3fce54bd2c321c513174.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42425666/8e98678a84d8bc172a013bbde953add795316117.png[/img]



[h3]＜Haruo Ayase＞[/h3]
Haruo is Taiga’s closest childhood friend. 
He has a baby face.  He is responsible for making Taiga take Minato High’s entry exam in exchange for becoming his strongest pitcher.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42425666/47212388ba8e8f172099f9cf1464d6d85dae239a.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42425666/9e639d1dc68eda6e1fe929089e76c0d0e42b42af.png[/img]




[h3]＜Kenji Kitagawa＞[/h3]
He is the younger brother of the previous Onishura King of Minato High. 
He can gather the toughest delinquents together using the motto “ Onishura Never Dies.”

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42425666/bba064e4fc38b26023f58fc89ecb79fae6f37ae3.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42425666/dcd4d27bd7f257dfb750fdc569475e06af764771.png[/img]

notes.title: BANCHO TACTICS Creator Letter 06.2022
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

I'm Ping, game producer of [b]Banchou Tactics[/b]. I really grateful for every wishlists and follow us.
This article, I will introduce the 5 main characters in this game.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42425666/d891ac8ae7865c56a80f77f88abea72540a640f4.png[/img]
An unknown student from Minato high school, but he becomes a famous delinquent in his sophomore year.

In the first year at Minato high school, he tried to resettle the baseball club with Haruo, his best friend.  He didn’t know that Kitagawa Seiichi, the Oni king at that time, was against the baseball club. 
During the week before the exam, Taiga went to the headquarter of the Oni Empire gang and fought many others.  He ended up in hospital and took an exam there.

Taiga is a good guy with outstanding physical strength. 
He valued his friends mostly. 
After his mother died, he started staying home alone because his dad was transferring abroad for work.



[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42425666/011e847bc7fa0490fcd575e24742e891dc3b0466.png[/img]
A former junior-high pitcher and the best buddy of Taiga since childhood. 
He’s the one who convinced Taiga to apply for Minato high school with a promise that he would turn Taiga to be the strongest pitcher in the world. 
Both shared a dream of Koshien together.

To survive in Minato high school, Haruo could not avoid fighting other students along with Taiga.  However, he’s quite a fine fighter himself since he was trained to be a baseball player before.
With his today looking, many high school girls saw him as attractive, but he’s not a flirt.  



[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42425666/218e901c655ebc9908080cd2e61d23266633cfa5.png[/img]
One of the strongest men in Minato high school.
He won the freshman war in the first year of school.
Whatsoever, he did not want to be a part of the Oni Empire gang and he’s very busy with his tight schedule, study & work.
Fatefully, he’s Taiga’s classmate in 2-C, so they’re friends and rivals at the same time. 

As a promising strongest fighter from Minato high school, Youto’s quite famous among defectors.
With his cool looking style, he’s also popular with high school girls too.
He’s an expert at kicking.  His feet could fly unpredictably.



[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42425666/180b90f91969b9ebf4edf76b6cbea358b16a0f2e.png[/img]
One of the second year leaders in Sakae high school.
Nickname for him is “Yellow Raccoon.”
It might sound funny, but he’s the one who won the freshman war in Sakae high school and held the most sophomores here in his team.
He’s such a straightforward person and faced a lot of rejections from his crush.

Atsuya used to follow Tetsuo, his senior in junior-high.
Because he could not pass an exam to get into Nakamura technic high school, he ended up being a Sakae student.



[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42425666/1812b696bc9c2e5c929fe0e7a98f05b816b73c41.png[/img]
The Strongest high school student in this town.
He held this title since the first year in Nakamura technic high school.
His strength is undoubtable.
He got a rumor of defeating a bear at the age of twelve when he went camping with his family.
A scar on his face came from that incident.

Even though Tetsuo bonded with some students in school, he spent more time in solitude.
He got so many secrets in his life and people around him kept fantasizing about his unknown adventures.



[h3]Afterwords[/h3]

So, what do you think of【Banchou Tactics】? 

And, Flyhigh Times is now accepting anonymous fan mail on our Marshmallow page!
If you have any impressions/thoughts on the article or questions you would like to ask the developer or production team, please send them our way!

notes.title: 【BANCHOU TACTICS】demo is now available during STEAM NEXT FEST！
notes.content:
[h2]The demo of Japanese high-school delinquent-themed Tactical Simulation RPG「BANCHOU TACTICS(番長タクティクス)」is now available during STEAM NEXT FEST！[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42425666/3f046c556e8246d3a59cdf2137676ac6c1d29389.jpg[/img]

Hello, everyone. I'm Kou, CEO of Flyhigh Works.

「SECRET CHARACTER」is a game studio based in Bangkok, Thailand that has planned and developed this Japanese delinquent-themed Tactical Simulation RPG titled「BANCHO TACTICS(番長タクティクス)」, which the demo version will be available on STEAM starting today.

This demo will also be available during STEAM NEXT FEST, so please check it out!

【Demo Launch Trailer】

[previewyoutube=OBhHesn3ka8;full][/previewyoutube]

● Game studio「SECRET CHARACTER」official Twitter account
[url=https://twitter.com/SecretCharGame]https://twitter.com/SecretCharGame[/url]



[h3]Game Presentation[/h3]

「BANCHOU TACTICS」is a turn-based tactical RPG that features Japanese high-school delinquents.
- High quality 2D pixel art on 3D stages
- Turn-based strategy combat system
- Inspired by『Crows』Japanese manga、『River City Ransom（Kunio-kun)』、『Final Fantasy Tactics』, etc.




[h3]Story[/h3]

 For several years somewhere in Japan, three high schools have been raging war: Sakae High School, Nakamura Technical High School, and Minato High School.

[b]"We run this city."[/b]

The delinquents who believed in that engaged in a war without humanity and justice day in and day out.

After Kitagawa Seiichi, known as the "Demon King of Minato High," graduated last year, the balance of power between the three schools became uncertain.

The game's story focuses on Taiga Arashi, a delinquent at Minato High School.



[h3]Screenshots[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42425666/ee6fab58804c56a510a438f8b4145604dbb07b31.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42425666/6cfbf40fa3a679849dc22c504b93d17778906afd.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42425666/0921c071a8b6b2e179905e1b410ecb227a9ff181.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42425666/3414db3fe6f89f9b4ad17fd8063f1877ddfcb6d4.png[/img]


[h3]Message from the Devs[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42425666/b11d692a44f55034f0008922cceafdd5614adee4.png[/img] 
 [b]SECRET CHARACTER STUDIO Ping[/b]

We are a small team based in Bangkok that loves Japanese manga, anime, culture, and everything.
We wanted to create games like the Japanese games we played as kids.

A few years ago, we developed a game called「Zombie Hero: Kiki strikes back」, which has over a million downloads.

We also released「Yakiniku Simulator」on STEAM and we are happy to see that so many Japanese VTubers played and enjoyed it! 

Also, our investor ITSARAAMATA loves Japanese culture. Their forte is creating concepts and stories. We at Secret Character share the same vision and are grateful for their support.

We are still in the middle of development, but we would feel encouraged if everyone could add our game to your STEAM Wishlist！




[h3]Afterword[/h3]

So what do you think of the information about this new game called「BANCHO TACTICS(番長タクティクス)」？

If you liked the demo, please be sure to add it to your STEAM Wishlist！

That’s the end of this article!
